items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Doc Severinsen had a small band to go up, so he was a member of that

ctx.x: Because he had … Doc Severinsen had a small band to go up, so he was a member of that, had like six singers or something, that kind of thing. And uh, and then they moved to Los Angeles. So that brought us to move to Los Angeles, ‟72, summer. And, at that time I decided I was going to quit because I, because … I didn‟t really make any impact, you know. I tried hard, I had my concert, got a good review and everything, but it didn‟t really change my life. And uh … so I decided maybe I should quit, because the world…
But, but, Toshiko-san, didn‟t you go to Japan again, for Expo 1970, before you went to move to Los Angeles?
